items.source: A stream that is no longer in use must be Disposable.dispose() disposed} otherwise the streams will linger and exhaust resources.
items.translation: 不再使用的流必须 Disposable.dispose() 进行释放，否则流将滞留并耗尽资源。

items.source:
The stream may become dead, or invalid, if either the query returns no match or the cursor returns the document at
the "end" of the collection and then the application deletes that document.
items.translation: 如果查询未返回匹配项，或者游标返回了集合“末尾”的文档随后应用程序删除了该文档，则流可能会变为无效或死锁。

items.source: Annotation to declare an infinite stream using MongoDB's tailable cursors. An infinite stream can only be used with capped collections. Objects are emitted through the stream as data is inserted into the collection. An infinite stream can only be used with streams that emit more than one element, such as Flux.
items.translation: 用于声明使用 MongoDB 的 tailable 游标的无限流注解。无限流仅可与 capped 集合一起使用。当数据插入到集合中时，对象会通过流发出。无限流仅可与发出多个元素的流（例如 Flux）一起使用。
